related_questions.question: What drug lowers blood pressure quickly?

text_blocks.snippet: Several medications can lower blood pressure quickly. ACE inhibitors, like enalapril or captopril, and certain diuretics, such as hydrochlorothiazide, are known for their relatively rapid onset of action. Calcium channel blockers can also provide quick relief.
snippet_highlighted_words: ACE inhibitors, like enalapril or captopril, and certain diuretics, such as hydrochlorothiazide

list.snippet: Enalapril: Can start lowering blood pressure within an hour.
Captopril: Effective in reducing blood pressure within 15-30 minutes in hypertensive emergencies.
Hydrochlorothiazide: Can start working within a few hours.
Thiazide diuretics: Generally considered first-line treatment for hypertension and can be effective in lowering blood pressure quickly.
Amlodipine: A commonly used calcium channel blocker that can quickly reduce blood pressure, according to advancedmedicalgroupnj.com.

list.title: Beta-blockers:
list.snippet: Medications like metoprolol can also lower blood pressure by slowing the heart rate.

list.title: Immediate Release:
list.snippet: Some medications are designed for immediate release to address hypertensive emergencies.

list.title: Individual Response:
list.snippet: The speed and extent of blood pressure reduction can vary between individuals and medications.

text_blocks.snippet: Important Note: It's crucial to consult with a healthcare professional for proper diagnosis and treatment of high blood pressure. Self-treating can be dangerous. They will determine the most appropriate medication and dosage based on your individual needs and medical history.
